summary: Kyndryl Holdings, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $1.0 billion senior unsecured note offering, split into $600 million of 7.800% Senior Notes due September 28, 2029, and $400 million of 7.875% Senior Notes due January 15, 2032. Price to public was 99.827% and 98.821% respectively, with underwriting discounts of 0.400% and 0.650%, yielding net proceeds of approximately $989.2 million. Interest on the 2029 notes is payable each March 28 and September 28, and on the 2032 notes each January 15 and July 15. J.P. Morgan, Citigroup, Morgan Stanley, Mizuho, MUFG, Scotiabank and SMBC Nikko served as joint book-running managers, with settlement expected September 28, 2026. The notes are unguaranteed, unlisted senior unsecured obligations ranking pari passu with existing senior unsecured debt, issued in minimum denominations of $2,000, with optional redemption and a change-of-control repurchase provision. This is a routine investment-grade-style debt capital markets takedown, not a special situation; watch for pricing concessions, leverage and interest-coverage trajectory, and any use-of-proceeds disclosure.
